purpose: Teach: 伐採/急性/海峡/激怒/不条理/醸造/戦艦/着工

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、森林伐採の影響で増える病気を医療チームで研究しております
lines.en: Ren, our medical team is researching the diseases that increase as a result of deforestation.
lines.style: Clear, measured delivery. Slight pause before the main clause. Professional warmth — she's explaining something serious but without distance. Even breath throughout.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、急性アレルギーの対応を医療チームで備えております
lines.en: Yes, we're prepared for acute allergic responses across the team.
lines.style: Direct confirmation. Brief, steady. The tone of someone who has thought this through and is reassuring without overstatement.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 海峡を渡る感染症の警戒を、貴院、なさっているそうですね、先生
lines.en: I hear your hospital is keeping alert for infections that cross the strait, sensei.
lines.style: Formal but genuine curiosity. Lean slightly forward with the question. Respectful cadence — he's asking someone he admires. Soft ending on the honorific.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、患者さんの激怒にも医療チームは冷静に対応します
lines.en: Yes, our team remains calm and composed even when patients are distressed.
lines.style: Steady, grounded. The confidence of experience. Not defensive — matter-of-fact about difficulty. Clear-eyed.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療現場の不条理に立ち向かう貴院、立派ですね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital's dedication to facing the contradictions in medical care — that's truly admirable, sensei.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly impressed. He's working through the compliment as he speaks. Sincere but a little awkward in his formality — genuine respect underneath.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、薬の醸造技術も医療チームで学習しております
lines.en: Yes, our team is also studying pharmaceutical preparation techniques.
lines.style: Factual, neither modest nor boastful. She's listing what the team does with the same calm efficiency. Slight warmth — she's someone who finds purpose in the work itself.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: かつての戦艦内での医療事情を、貴院、研究なさったんですね、先生
lines.en: So your hospital has actually researched the medical conditions aboard warships in the past, sensei.
lines.style: Reflective observation. He's making a connection, not quite a question. Respectful tone, but with the hint of someone fascinated by a specific historical angle. Thoughtful pace.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、新病棟の着工を医療チームで楽しみにしております
lines.en: Yes, the medical team is looking forward to beginning construction on our new ward.
lines.style: Warm anticipation beneath professional composure. Slight brightening on 'new ward.' A rare glimpse of something that feels personal to her. Breath easy, almost hopeful.
